course.learn: Asset management tracks hardware, software, and data from acquisition through assignment, operation, maintenance, and secure disposal. A reliable inventory links assets to owners, location, status, and security requirements.
course.why: Organizations cannot patch, monitor, classify, or decommission assets they do not know exist.
course.example: A laptop is recorded at purchase, assigned to an employee, monitored in inventory, wiped at return, and physically destroyed or reused according to policy.
course.exam: Inventory/ownership/lifecycle are key. Disposal must include appropriate data sanitization or destruction before equipment leaves control.
